name: KPJ Healthcare Berhad
overview: 2026年公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权、公司秘书变更及一项重大诉讼，未见有关业务板块扩张、新增、缩减、出售或取得合约的公告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长16.9%，净利润同比增长26.6%。
overview_en: In 2026, announcements mainly covered quarterly results, dividend ex-dates, changes of company secretary and a material litigation; no announcements related to business segment expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract awards were observed. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 16.9% year-on-year and net profit grew 26.6% year-on-year.
